visualCharacteristics.purpose: Image next to a promotional text panel with CTA
visualCharacteristics.description: Two-part side-by-side layout: image on the left, text panel on the right (eyebrow, heading, paragraph, optional bullet list, CTA) at desktop widths; stacked on mobile.

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: image (image + imageAlt). Row 2: richtext (optional eyebrow, heading, description, bullet list, CTA link)

reuseGuidance: Use for a single image + promotional text panel pair (e.g. bundle or product callout banners).
